# Object storage API

Manage team buckets and objects. Bucket names are globally unique. Object uploads use the raw file body. Newly created S3 credentials appear in responses; keep those responses private.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/object_bucket` | [List buckets](#op-get-v1-object-bucket) |
| `POST` | `/v1/object_bucket` | [Create bucket](#op-post-v1-object-bucket) |
| `GET` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}` | [Get bucket](#op-get-v1-object-bucket-id) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}` | [Update bucket](#op-put-v1-object-bucket-id) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}` | [Delete bucket](#op-delete-v1-object-bucket-id) |
| `GET` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/objects` | [List bucket objects](#op-get-v1-object-bucket-id-objects) |
| `GET` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/object` | [Download bucket object](#op-get-v1-object-bucket-id-object) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/object` | [Upload bucket object](#op-put-v1-object-bucket-id-object) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/object` | [Delete bucket object](#op-delete-v1-object-bucket-id-object) |
| `POST` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/folders` | [Create bucket folder](#op-post-v1-object-bucket-id-folders) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/folders` | [Delete bucket folder](#op-delete-v1-object-bucket-id-folders) |
| `GET` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/access-keys` | [List bucket access keys](#op-get-v1-object-bucket-id-access-keys) |
| `POST` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/access-keys` | [Create bucket access key](#op-post-v1-object-bucket-id-access-keys) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/object_bucket/{id}/access-keys/{access_key_id}` | [Delete bucket access key](#op-delete-v1-object-bucket-id-access-keys-access-key-id) |

## List buckets {#op-get-v1-object-bucket}

`GET /v1/object_bucket`

Returns a paginated list of ObjectBucket

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/object_bucket" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of ObjectBucket

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].acl_policy` | object | Adios object ACL policy. Defaults to private with optional public prefix rules. |
| `data[].backend_bucket` | string | Provider bucket name. Defaults to the normalized object bucket name. |
| `data[].bucket_id` | string |  |
| `data[].cache_policy` | object | Gateway cache policy for public object reads. |
| `data[].canonical_hostname` | string | Generated Adios bucket hostname such as bucket.s3.adios.dev. |
| `data[].cdn_policy` | object | Adios CDN policy for public object reads. Overrides cache_policy when set. |
| `data[].config` | object | Additional provider options and secret references. |
| `data[].cors_policy` | object | S3 CORS policy enforced by Adios before proxying to the object backend. |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].endpoint` | string | Optional S3-compatible endpoint override for imported buckets. |
| `data[].managed` | boolean |  |
| `data[].name` | string | Globally unique bucket namespace used for bucket.s3.adios.dev and s3.adios.dev/bucket routing. |
| `data[].provider` | string |  Allowed: adios, minio, ceph_rgw, external_s3. |
| `data[].public_hostname` | string | Optional user-owned custom hostname served through the anycast gateway for bucket access; adios.dev and adios.run namespaces are reserved. |
| `data[].public_read` | boolean |  |
| `data[].region` | string |  |
| `data[].route_id` | string | Gateway route synced for public_hostname custom domains. |
| `data[].s3_path_endpoint` | string | Shared path-style S3 endpoint such as https://s3.adios.dev. |
| `data[].status` | string |  Allowed: pending, available, failed, deleted. |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].versioning` | boolean |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

Illustrative example; not a live response:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "acl_policy": {},
      "backend_bucket": "example",
      "bucket_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "cache_policy": {},
      "canonical_hostname": "example",
      "cdn_policy": {},
      "config": {},
      "cors_policy": {},
      "created_at": 1791072000,
      "deleted_at": 0,
      "endpoint": "example",
      "managed": true,
      "name": "postman-example",
      "provider": "adios",
      "public_hostname": "example",
      "public_read": false,
      "region": "default",
      "route_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "s3_path_endpoint": "example",
      "status": "pending",
      "team_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "updated_at": 1791072000,
      "versioning": false
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 1,
    "total": 1
  }
}
```
